title: Cardinal Billing Account Pay Plan Schedule: Billing of Additional and Return Premium
content:
When an endorsement on the auto policy leaves additional premium or return premium behind it, the Cardinal Billing Account handles that premium by the method its pay plan sets.

| Pay plan | Additional premium billing method | Immediate-bill due days | Return premium method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | Spread over the remaining installments | 20 | Reduce the remaining installments |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | Spread over the remaining installments | 20 | Reduce the remaining installments |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | Spread over the remaining installments | 20 | Reduce the remaining installments |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | Spread over the remaining installments | 20 | Reduce the remaining installments |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | Spread over the remaining installments | 20 | Reduce the remaining installments |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | Bill immediately | 20 | Credit the balance |

## Terms used in the table

- **Spread over the remaining installments**: additional premium is divided over the installments of the term not yet billed.
- **Bill immediately**: additional premium is billed at once.
- **Immediate-bill due days**: the number of calendar days in which an additional premium billed at once falls due. Every plan uses 20 calendar days.
- **Reduce the remaining installments**: return premium lowers the installments not yet billed.
- **Credit the balance**: return premium is credited against the account balance at once.

Only the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan bills additional premium immediately and credits return premium to the balance; the five installment plans spread additional premium and reduce remaining installments.
